method: Actual viewing of all 16 saved four-way RAW pages, two fixed views plus inherited front/side sections. CC/UU prior RAW labels rechecked and retained. No source-style matching. A YES is macroscopic adoption, not exact connectivity or clean geometry.

limitations: Nonblind AI_PROXY, no human rating. Thin-cap C has ambiguous use. 943dde/n0 UC is borderline; a sensitivity count treating it as YES is reported separately. Section endpoints alone are not cracks; topology is taken from original scorer.
